## Invitations

A total of 1393 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Attendance was 269, giving an attendance rate of 19.3 per cent. This provides a clear indication of the level of engagement achieved during the reporting period. Staff continued to support access for residents by maintaining van days where road conditions allowed. This approach helped the service remain available across the district, including locations affected by local travel constraints. Attendance information has been recorded to support review of the invitation and engagement process.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by sms, with the recorded total remaining 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded total for reminders was also 0. Contact activity therefore relied on the initial invitation and the arrangements made through local outreach. The results should be considered when planning future contact methods and assessing whether additional reminders or alternative communication channels would improve attendance. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
